title: Kenyan Lamb Biryani
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired biryani dish made with Kenyan lamb, featuring a delicate balance of spices and aromatic basmati rice.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add garam masala, cumin, and coriander; stir for 1 minute.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Prepare biryani rice according to package instructions.
Layer cooked lamb and rice in a bowl.
Garnish with a pillow of rice and serve.
